'''1996 Ralltiir Regionals (Norway)''' was a Star Wars CCG regional qualifier for the [[1996 Decipher World Championship]], one of two in the Ralltiir region. Its winner earned a place at the World Championship.<ref name="dec96">[http://www.decipher.com/swccg/tournaments/regionalfinals.html Regional Championship Finalists], Decipher (1996). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19961121232352/http://www.decipher.com/swccg/tournaments/regionalfinals.html Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Bjørn Sørgjerd|Bjorn Sorgjerd]] of Trondheim, Norway won it.<ref name="dec96" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional qualifier (Ralltiir B)
* '''Date:''' 8–10 November 1996
* '''Site:''' Hexacon, Norway
